notes.title: Version 1.2 was released!
notes.notes:
What has been changed:


 Now it is impossible to drown in shallow areas
 A control tutorial has been added
 Many puzzles have had hints added or simplified
 Puzzles in the seagull area have been made clearer (solutions have not been changed)
 The hint for the 6th puzzle in the Octopus area has been changed to make the puzzle clearer
 Twisting indicators have been added to the terminals in the Elephant area
 The duration of the final phrase at the end of the game has been increased
 Some bugs have been fixed
 Minor gameplay and visual changes

notes.title: Version 1.1 was released
notes.notes:
List of changes:
-headbob was disabled
-added clarification to puzzle 6 in the octopus area
-changed the environment hint in puzzle 3 in the octopus area
-changed the solution to puzzle 3 in the bull zone (now the solution starts in a more correct place)
-fixed a bug in the 2nd puzzle in the area of the bull, which removed the walls if you look through the window
